cases.name: Renee Sue Whitnack-O'Neal
cases.about: Her obituary said Renee loved swimming & was a talented singer, known for her bright personality and she will forever be remembered as a passionate and loving animal advocate. However, nothing will ever compare to Renee's love and dedication to her twin sons who were the center of her world; being a mom to her boys was the most important and honored priority in Renee's life.
